name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Tangerine Dream
description: Taste sweet citrus sunshine and a creamy vanilla finish with Tangerine Dream BITEZ gummies! Each double-stacked gummy layers bright, zesty tangerine with smooth vanilla cream for that iconic orange creamsicle flavor. Infused with a powerful Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend, each gummy delivers 1,000mg per piece (2 gummies per bag, 2,000mg total). Your favorite childhood treat meets maximum cannabinoid potency in every nostalgic, euphoric bite.
